data.Name: Mysterious Mushroom Circle
data.Description: A perfect ring of mushrooms in every color of the rainbow plus some colors that shouldn't exist. They're gently pulsing with light and making a sound like tiny jazz music. A sign in the center reads 'DO NOT' but the rest is eaten by mushrooms.
